reply.thought: Checking batch ledger via tools; compute nothing locally. First list orders/refunds to identify customers, then confirm net balances before paying.
Now verify refunds list and then use net_balance per customer to ensure correct net amounts; refunds applied by Alpha should be reflected in ledger.
Refunds tool output doesn't match Alpha handoff (missing order 124 refund). This is a concrete discrepancy; hold for human review before paying.
